**Ayala Malls Manila Bay** is a major shopping, dining, and entertainment complex located in **Paranaque City, Metro Manila, Philippines**, near the **Entertainment City** gaming district and **NAIA (Ninoy Aquino International Airport)**. Developed by **Ayala Land**, it is one of the largest and most modern malls in the country, offering a mix of high-end and mainstream retail, leisure, and lifestyle experiences.

Here’s everything you need to know about **Ayala Malls Manila Bay**:

---

### **📍 Location & Accessibility**
- **Address:** Aseana Ave., Tambo, Paranaque City, 1700 Metro Manila
- **Nearby Landmarks:**
  - **NAIA Terminals 1, 2, and 3** (10–15 min drive)
  - **Entertainment City** (City of Dreams, Solaire, Okada Manila)
  - **SMX Convention Center & World Trade Center Metro Manila**
  - **Cuneta Astrodome**
  - **Macapagal Boulevard & POEA (Philippine Overseas Employment Administration)**
- **Public Transport:**
  - **Bus:** P2P buses from Alabang, Makati, and other areas.
  - **Jeepney/UV Express:** Routes from Baclaran, Taft Ave., and NAIA.
  - **Ride-Hailing:** Grab, Angkas, Joyride (pick-up/drop-off zones available).
  - **Future Access:** Expected to be connected to the **NAIA Airport Railway** (under construction).

---

### **🏢 Mall Overview**
- **Developer:** Ayala Land (part of the **Ayala Malls** chain, which includes Greenbelt, Glorietta, BGC, etc.)
- **Total Gross Floor Area:** ~**180,000 sqm** (one of the largest Ayala Malls)
- **Floors:** **4 levels** (including basement parking)
- **Parking:** **Multi-level parking** with over **2,000 slots**
- **Opening Date:** **September 2020** (soft opening), **Fully opened in 2021** (delayed due to COVID-19)
- **Design:** Modern, **coastal-inspired architecture** with open spaces, natural light, and **al fresco dining areas**.

---

### **🛍️ Shopping & Retail**
Ayala Malls Manila Bay features a **mix of local and international brands**, from luxury to mid-range and fast fashion.

#### **🏬 Anchor Stores & Major Retailers**
- **Department Stores:**
  - **The Landmark (first in the South)** – Supermarket, home goods, and fashion.
  - **Zara**
  - **H&M**
  - **Uniqlo**
  - **Mango**
  - **GU (Uniqlo’s sister brand)**
- **Electronics & Gadgets:**
  - **Abenson**
  - **Memoxpress**
  - **Digital Walker**
  - **Silicon Valley**
- **Beauty & Pharmacy:**
  - **Watsons**
  - **The Face Shop**
  - **Innisfree**
  - **Merury Drug**
- **Home & Lifestyle:**
  - **Our Home**
  - **Muelle**
  - ** Ace Hardware**
  - **Dyson (first standalone store in the Philippines)**
- **Luxury & High-End:**
  - **Pandora**
  - **Swarovski**
  - **Michael Kors**
  - **Coach**
  - **Fossil**
  - **Tissot**

#### **🛍️ Specialty Stores & Concepts**
- **The Travel Club** (Ayala’s in-house travel retail store)
- **The Body Shop**
- **Lush**
- **Victoria’s Secret Beauty**
- **Sephora (first in the South)**
- **Miniso**
- **Daiso Japan**
- **National Book Store**

#### **💎 Jewelry & Watches**
- **Oro Italia**
- **Jewelmer**
- **Timex**
- **Casio**
- **Seiko**

---

### **🍽️ Dining & Food Options**
One of the mall’s **strongest features** is its **diverse food scene**, with **over 100 dining options**, including **first-in-the-Philippines** and **exclusive branches**.

#### **🍴 Restaurants & Cafés**
- **Fine Dining & Upscale:**
  - **Din Tai Fung** (famous for xiao long bao)
  - **Tim Ho Wan** (Michelin-starred dim sum)
  - **Shake Shack** (first branch in the South)
  - **The Halal Guys** (first in the Philippines)
  - **P.F. Chang’s**
  - **Texas Roadhouse**
  - **The Wholesome Table** (healthy, farm-to-table)
- **Casual & Family Dining:**
  - **Max’s Restaurant**
  - **Jollibee**
  - **McDonald’s**
  - **KFC**
  - **Pizza Hut**
  - ** Yellow Cab**
  - **Italianni’s**
  - **Friday’s**
  - **TGI Fridays**
- **Cafés & Desserts:**
  - **Starbucks Reserve** (first in the South)
  - **The Coffee Bean & Tea Leaf**
  - **Bo’s Coffee**
  - **Single Origin**
  - **Lady M** (famous for mille crepe cakes)
  - **Coscouscu** (Japanese cheesecake)
  - **Baskin-Robbins**
  - **Dairy Queen**
  - **Honey Cream** (Korean soft serve)
- **Fast-Casual & International:**
  - **Burger King**
  - **Shakey’s**
  - **Mang Inasal**
  - **Chowking**
  - **Ramen Nagi**
  - **Iketeru (Hilton’s Japanese restaurant, first mall branch)**
  - **Sushi Groove**
  - **Kimgane (Korean BBQ)**
  - **Sbarro**
- **Food Halls & Kiosks:**
  - **The Bazaar (Food Hall)** – A mix of local and international cuisines.
  - **Korean food stalls**
  - **Street food & kiosks** (e.g., **Potato Corner, Pretzel Time, Cinnabon**)

#### **🍻 Bars & Nightlife (Limited but Growing)**
- **The Distillery** (whiskey & cocktails)
- **Manam Comfort Filipino Food** (has a bar section)
- **Some bars in the al fresco area**

---

### **🎬 Entertainment & Leisure**
Ayala Malls Manila Bay is designed as a **lifestyle hub**, not just a shopping destination.

#### **🎭 Cinemas**
- **Ayala Malls Cinemas** (formerly **Cinema Centenario**)
  - **7 theaters** (including **Director’s Club** for premium viewing)
  - **IMAX** (first in an Ayala Mall)
  - **4DX** (motion seats, wind, water effects)
  - **Dolby Atmos & 3D screens**

#### **🎤 Events & Performances**
- **The Col Rodney (Event Space)** – Hosts **concerts, launches, and exhibits**.
- **Outdoor Stage** – Free performances, live bands, and cultural shows.
- **Seasonal Events** (e.g., Christmas village, summer fairs)

#### **👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Family & Kids’ Attractions**
- **Timezone** (arcade & gaming)
- **KidZania Manila** (interactive role-playing city for kids) – **First in the South!**
- **Play Nation** (indoor playground)
- **The Mind Museum Experience** (science exhibits, rotating displays)

#### **🏋️‍♂️ Fitness & Wellness**
- **Fitness First** (gym & fitness center)
- **Anytime Fitness**
- **Yoga studios & wellness centers**

---

### **💰 Services & Amenities**
- **Banks & ATMs:** BPI, BDO, Metrobank, RCBC, Security Bank, UnionBank
- **Money Changers & Remittance:** Western Union, Cebuana Lhuillier, Palawan Express
- **Salons & Spas:**
  - **David’s Salon**
  - **Folded & Hung (laundry services)**
  - **Nail salons (e.g., Nailaholics, Tip N Toe)**
- **Medical & Dental Clinics:**
  - **Healthway**
  - **The Medical City Clinic**
- **Other Services:**
  - **Laundromat (Laundry King)**
  - **Pet Store (Pet Express)**
  - **Post Office (PhilPost branch nearby)**
  - **Free Wi-Fi** (via Ayala Malls app)
  - **Charging stations & mobile phone repair kiosks**

---

### **🎉 Unique Features & Highlights**
✅ **Firsts in the Philippines/South:**
- **First KidZania in the South**
- **First IMAX in an Ayala Mall**
- **First Starbucks Reserve in the South**
- **First The Halal Guys in the Philippines**
- **First The Travel Club store**

✅ **Al Fresco Dining & Open Spaces:**
- **The Bay Park** – Outdoor seating with views of **Manila Bay sunset**.
- **The Boardwalk** – A promenade with restaurants and a relaxed vibe.

✅ **Eco-Friendly & Smart Mall Features:**
- **Solar panels** (part of Ayala Land’s sustainability efforts)
- **Rainwater harvesting system**
- **LED lighting & energy-efficient systems**
- **Bike-friendly** (bike racks available)

✅ **Proximity to Entertainment & Tourism:**
- **5-min drive to Solaire, City of Dreams, Okada Manila** (casinos & resorts)
- **Near PDOT (Philippine Department of Tourism) headquarters**
- **Close to NAIA, making it a stop for travelers**

---

### **🕒 Operating Hours**
- **Mall Hours:**
  - **Monday–Thursday:** 10:00 AM – 9:00 PM
  - **Friday–Sunday & Holidays:** 10:00 AM – 10:00 PM
- **Restaurants & Cafés:** Some stay open until **11:00 PM or midnight**.
- **Cinemas:** First show at **10:00 AM**, last show around **10:00–11:00 PM**.
- **Supermarkets (The Landmark):** 9:00 AM – 10:00 PM

*(Hours may vary; check official social media for updates.)*

---

### **📱 Digital & Loyalty Programs**
- **Ayala Malls Circle Rewards** – Earn points for shopping, dining, and services.
- **Ayala Malls Mobile App** – Check promotions, movie schedules, and mall maps.
- **Contactless Payments** – GCash, GrabPay, and credit/debit cards widely accepted.

---

### **🚗 Parking & Transportation Tips**
- **Parking Rates:**
  - **First 3 hours:** ₱50
  - **Succeeding hours:** ₱20/hour
  - **Overnight parking:** ₱200 (from 10:00 PM – 6:00 AM)
  - **Valet Parking:** Available (₱100–₱200)
- **EV Charging Stations:** Available for electric vehicles.
- **Drop-off/Pick-up Zones:** Designated areas for ride-hailing (Grab, etc.).
- **Shuttle Services:** Some hotels and condos in the area provide free shuttles.

---

### **📅 Upcoming Developments & Expansions**
- **Phase 2 Expansion:** More retail and dining spaces in the works.
- **Office Tower:** Nearby **Aseana One** and **Aseana Two** office buildings attract BPO workers, boosting mall foot traffic.
- **Residential Integration:** Future condominiums by Ayala Land near the mall.

---

### **⭐ Reviews & Reputation**
- **Pros:**
  - **Spacious, clean, and well-ventilated** (good airflow, not too crowded).
  - **Great food variety** (one of the best dining selections in Metro Manila).
  - **Family-friendly** (KidZania, Timezone, open spaces).
  - **Convenient location** (near airport, casinos, and business districts).
  - **Modern design** (aesthetic interiors, Instagram-worthy spots).
- **Cons:**
  - **Far from central Manila** (traffic can be an issue, especially from Makati/BGC).
  - **Limited nightlife** (fewer bars compared to BGC or Makati).
  - **Some areas still under development** (not yet fully maximized).

**Rating on Google:** ⭐ **4.5/5** (based on thousands of reviews)

---

### **📌 Social Media & Contact Information**
- **Website:** [www.ayalamalls.com/manilabay](https://www.ayalamalls.com/manilabay)
- **Facebook:** [Ayala Malls Manila Bay](https://www.facebook.com/AyalaMallsManilaBay)
- **Instagram:** [@ayalamallsmanilabay](https://www.instagram.com/ayalamallsmanilabay/)
- **Customer Service:**
  - **Phone:** (02) 8777 6000 (Ayala Malls Hotline)
  - **Email:** customercare@ayalaland.com.ph

---

### **💡 Tips for Visitors**
1. **Best Time to Visit:** **Weekdays (10 AM–3 PM)** to avoid crowds.
2. **Parking:** Arrive **before 11 AM** for easier parking.
3. **Dining Reservations:** Popular restaurants (Din Tai Fung, Tim Ho Wan) may have long queues—**book in advance**.
4. **Free Shuttle:** Some **hotels in NAIA and Entertainment City** offer free shuttles to the mall.
5. **Suning Down at Bay Park:** The **sunset view** from the al fresco area is stunning—**great for photos!**
6. **Bring a Power Bank:** The mall is huge, and you might need extra charge for your phone.

---
---
### **🔚 Final Verdict**
**Ayala Malls Manila Bay** is a **premium lifestyle destination** that combines **shopping, dining, entertainment, and relaxation** in a **modern, well-designed space**. It’s **ideal for:**
✔ **Families** (KidZania, playgrounds, spacious walkways)
✔ **Foodies** (huge variety of cuisines)
✔ **Travelers** (close to NAIA, casinos, and hotels)
✔ **Shoppers** (high-end and mainstream brands)
✔ **Movie Buffs** (IMAX, 4DX, premium theaters)

If you're in **Paranaque, Las Piñas, or near NAIA**, this mall is a **must-visit**—especially for its **food, Cinemas, and KidZania**.
